rules: PRODUCTION_SPEC §12–§18; flat LIGHT backgrounds only (no black) — Razer photos have dark studio backgrounds: cut the mice out (or place as rounded framed cards) on the flat colour; whole real products; 1–3 words; 2-D objects next to the product; watermark below content; logo v5 end card; audio LOCKED (narrate.py + mix.sh). Length 50–58 s.
official_clips: none — Razer product pages expose no downloadable video file; no YouTube/promo clips (reused-content rule)
palette_for_this_video: paper #FAF8F5 main; lavender #ECE8FB for the weight/name beats; blush #FBE7E2 for THE CATCH; marigold object fills; ember accent text and price figures

scenes.image: A hero (two carbon mice), cut out, centred 80% width
scenes.object: two-pan balance scale: left pan '$90' coin stack drops, right pan a tiny '2 g' weight — beam barely moves
scenes.note: frame 1 must read instantly: mice + $90 + 2 g

scenes.object: '2 g' weight tile pulses; magnifying glass hovers over it

scenes.anchor: Carbon Fiber Viper V4 Pro and DeathAdder V4 Pro
scenes.object: two name labels slide in on leader lines: VIPER (left), DEATHADDER (right)

scenes.image: E (Viper top view banner), crop to mouse, scale 70%
scenes.object: flat woven-weave pattern tile wipes across a shell silhouette next to the mouse
price tag on a string swings in, hangs off the Viper
digital kitchen scale under the mouse, display counts 0→47 g (0.33 s roll, hold ≥1.2 s)
second scale beside first: '49 g' + tag '$159.99' (label 'normal Viper'); bracket between scales shows '−2 g / +$90'

scenes.anchor: drops from fifty-six grams to forty-nine
scenes.object: bar chart 2 bars: 56 g (grey) shrinks to 49 g (ember); delta label '−7 g'
delta label flips to price: '+$80' (249.99 − 169.99 shown small under it)
two horizontal bars: ABS plastic 100 % (grey) vs carbon 153 % (marigold); small footnote 'Razer internal test'
warning tag flips down from top edge

scenes.anchor: hundred and eighty hour battery is at one thousand hertz
scenes.object: battery icon full, label '180 h' with dial set to '1,000 Hz'

scenes.anchor: At eight thousand, it's forty-five hours
scenes.object: dial turns to '8,000 Hz'; battery drains to a quarter, label '45 h'

scenes.anchor: just want carbon in your hand
scenes.object: hand-cursor icon taps the Viper; small 'for carbon fans only' sticker

scenes.anchor: pay ninety dollars to save two grams
scenes.object: balance scale exactly as frame 1 (seamless loop)
